replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body: Hmm maybe try re adding your email to you avicus profile. Delete it, save your profile, and then re add it. Maybe that might work. Regarding the first point you have to confirm your gravatar account, you have to also confirm that account before you can use gravatar avatars.
